result.detail:
Traceability: this work serves [requirement:req-df40b5a460] and implements the approved specifications, whose reviews are [evidence:prj-55105a9add.interface-spec.e1] and [evidence:prj-55105a9add.microarchitecture.e1].

Recorded decisions and gaps:
(1) The holding registers aw_addr_q, w_data_q and w_strb_q have no reset, following section 2 of the microarchitecture. They are read only while their held flag is set, and that flag is reset.
(2) The microarchitecture verification plan lists axi4_lite_regs_tb_fail.v and axi4_lite_regs.sby. Neither is produced here. The task's expected outputs are rtl_source and testbench, and an unverified sby would add an unproven formal gate. A follow-up task can submit the sby against the FORMAL block that is already in the RTL.
(3) With the default ADDR_WIDTH of 4, the >>4 term in the address decode is constant-true. It is kept so the decode stays correct if the address is widened, as the microarchitecture says.
(4) A read and a write to the same register on the same cycle return the old value. The specs do not define this case, so the testbench avoids it.
(5) There are no `timescale directives anywhere, which avoids Verilator TIMESCALEMOD mismatches.
